row_alpha_score_positions.search_block_scores: 48 row-split units * 10 alphas = 480 block search losses

candidate_block_forward_budget.native_local_block_selected_metric_reuse: alpha=1, search-selected local alpha, and search-selected block alpha are read from the held ten-alpha landscape; no extra candidate block forward is needed
candidate_block_forward_budget.one_forward_definition: one candidate full decoder-layer forward for one full 2048-token document and one row-alpha intervention

separately_counted_non_candidate_forward.quantized_prefix_capture: 64 documents * 24 M2 quantized decoder layers = 1536 decoder-layer forwards, plus embedding capture

separately_counted_search_work.hessian_and_hinv: one independent search-only H/Hinv per target-cell and split = 12 preparations
separately_counted_search_work.held_local_selected_scores: calculated by direct Linear scoring of alpha=1/local-selected/block-selected rows; no block forward
